children: Anteris Technologies appointed Brent Moen as Chief Financial Officer, effective September 11, 2026, and transitioned Matthew McDonnell to Head of Australia on the same date.
Head of Australia (ceased serving as Chief Financial Officer)
Replaced as CFO by Brent Moen

Age 59; 25+ years leadership; prior CFO roles at LifeLens Technologies (Sep 2023–Mar 2026), Tactile Systems Technology (Sep 2018–Apr 2023), Entellus Medical (May 2016–Mar 2018); BAcc, University of North Dakota; eligible for salary $475,000, bonus up to 50% (prorated 2026), long-term incentive award target $500,000, severance of nine months' salary, COBRA premium reimbursement for nine months.
Will continue as employee under current compensation and benefit arrangements.
